@graph.name: AGIAS
@graph.description: One person, a machinist, directs an AI secretary and the AI systems under it. Send a short brief and get a running thing and its ledger: generative systems, nightly research, autonomous operations. Everything on the site runs on GENERATIVE MACHINE. Humans control the AI: a human decides what to build and when to stop, and everything is recorded.

@graph.name: GENERATIVE SYSTEMS
@graph.serviceType: A generator that keeps producing images and motion on a schedule, with a ledger
@graph.description: A machine that keeps generating for you: images, motion, text, and data, made automatically on the schedule you set. You give what to make and who uses it, what you already have (documents, data, existing material), a reference for the result, and where it is used. You get your own machine: it runs on the schedule you set, exports what it made each time, and records what it made and why; output as files, or as a page that opens anywhere. Built on GENERATIVE MACHINE and the nightly job base.

@graph.name: NIGHTLY RESEARCH
@graph.serviceType: Nightly technology scan with a reasoned ledger
@graph.description: Your own machine scans the field at night. You give your field and your criteria. You get, each morning, what the night's scan of GitHub, papers, and primary sources found; what to adopt and what to skip, each with its reason, in a ledger; and once a week a digest of the essentials. Built on Evolver Engine.

@graph.name: AUTONOMOUS OPERATIONS
@graph.serviceType: AI secretary, nightly jobs, and a window that receives requests
@graph.description: A setup that keeps working while you sleep, within the budget you set. You give where your records live (notes, mail), the routine work to hand over, and what its result should look like. You get a secretary AI, nightly jobs, and a window that receives requests; records, incoming requests, and routine work run on their own; runs stop at your budget cap and never loop endlessly; every decision is recorded. Built on the setup that runs AGIAS itself: secretary AI, nightly jobs, a window that receives requests.

step.text: You send what you want to make.
We set the direction; the secretary AI drafts the spec; you confirm it.
What you get first is a running prototype, not a slide.
You adjust in chat; every decision is recorded in the ledger, where you can manage it.
Delivery: the running machine and its ledger. A nightly check after delivery can be built on request.

@graph.name: GENERATIVE MACHINE
@graph.description: The system behind everything on the site: it generates images, renders sound, grows mandalas, and keeps a ledger of its decisions. AI builds it. Humans use it.

@graph.name: IMAGE MACHINE
@graph.description: Will learn from the prompts used so far and keep generating images on its own through an image-generation platform.

@graph.name: Evolver Engine
@graph.description: Every night it scans GitHub, papers, and primary sources, proposes what to adopt, and records the reason. A line in the ledger before a line of code.

@graph.name: GAIA
@graph.description: A virtual earth simulation: 195 countries and 80 million people (one hundredth of the real population) built from UN and World Bank statistics. Started 2026-08-28; its in-world clock began on 2022-11-30 and is still advancing. Each day a panel of 10,000 people decides what it did.
